title: ConsoleInstallService
responsibility: Installs the console into a SvelteKit host and records exactly which files it wrote.

inputs.name: ConsoleInstallService.install.options
inputs.description: Selects the SvelteKit host, policy module/export and console base path, with optional history input, storage binding and conflict handling. `data` and `bucket` default to undefined (no data is indexed and bundle storage is used), `prefix` defaults to "", and `update`/`keep` default to undefined; `update === true` replaces held content, while `keep` leaves it host-owned unless update is true.

inputs.name: ConsoleInstallService.restore.host
inputs.description: Filesystem root of the SvelteKit host whose console manifest and files are used by restore. It is the base for reading and writing that host's manifest and files.

inputs.name: ConsoleInstallService.restore.path
inputs.description: File path under `host` whose latest recorded change is to be restored. If no saved replaced contents are available for that path, restore raises ExpectedCliError.

outputs.name: ConsoleInstallService.install
outputs.description: Resolves with host/base/policy details, file paths written/removed/kept, recorded content changes, indexed data counts, storage and bundle size, and warnings. `data` is null when no history directory is supplied, and `bundle` is null when nothing is bundled.

outputs.name: ConsoleInstallService.restore
outputs.description: Resolves with the change record created when the latest saved content for `path` is restored. It records the displaced and restored content identities, the displaced copy's project-local path, the action, reason and timestamp.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: An expected CLI error raised when install finds conflicting content without an update/keep decision, or restore finds no saved replaced contents for the requested path. Install raises before applying its planned file writes, and restore raises before updating the manifest.

errors.description: Raised when no saved replaced contents are available for the requested path, including when there is no recorded change or its saved copy cannot be read.
